subject.title: fix(diagnostics-otel): classify model calls as client spans

question: Should legacy-named model-call spans change from implicit `INTERNAL` to explicit `CLIENT`, accepting that existing telemetry consumers may need filter updates?
rationale: The implementation matches outgoing provider-call semantics, but changing an exported span field for existing installations is an intentional compatibility choice that automated review cannot authorize.

options.title: Adopt CLIENT classification
options.body: Merge the narrow fix and treat dashboard filter updates as the accepted cost of correcting model-provider dependency classification.

options.title: Preserve legacy classification
options.body: Keep `CLIENT` behind the experimental semantic-convention opt-in and close or revise this PR to avoid changing existing telemetry consumers.

recommendation.title: Adopt CLIENT classification
recommendation.body: Merge the narrow fix and treat dashboard filter updates as the accepted cost of correcting model-provider dependency classification.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the current model-call telemetry helper and is the strongest history-based owner for deciding its exported compatibility contract.
